files.name: test_analysis
files.about: The analysis building blocks: attribution, alerts, roll-down, overfitting check and resampling.

files.name: test_clean_data
files.about: The cleaned dataset, contract by contract: one test per check per contract, so a failure names the contract.

files.name: test_costs
files.about: Transaction costs: every fee and tax charged on the right side, at the right rate, on the right base.

files.name: test_daily_update
files.about: The daily job's publish gate: good updates pass, every kind of bad update is rejected.

files.name: test_docs
files.about: The front-page README states only what the data and results say.

files.name: test_events
files.about: The dated event notes on the site's charts (EVENTS in dashboard/app/lib.js), checked against the MCX data.

files.name: test_ingest
files.about: Reading one MCX Bhavcopy download (ingest.read_one), on small hand-made files that reproduce each format trap.

files.name: test_no_lookahead
files.about: No look-ahead, anywhere a signal is computed: rewriting the future must not change the past.

files.name: test_protocol
files.about: The test protocol itself: rules frozen before the sealed data, sealed results never touched afterwards.

files.name: test_raw_files
files.about: Provenance: every MCX file in raw_clean/ is re-read from scratch and checked against the clean data.

files.name: test_robustness
files.about: robustness.py: each statistic on cases with a known answer, then the stored results recomputed.

files.name: test_site_build
files.about: The published site: built pages, every term it defines, every source it cites, everything it links to.

files.name: test_site_data
files.about: The website's numbers: every figure in dashboard/data.json must match the files it was computed from.

files.name: test_site_format
files.about: The site's own formatting helpers (dashboard/app/lib.js), run in Node with the real exported data.

files.name: test_specs
files.about: Contract specifications: every module must agree on lot size, quote size and purity.

files.name: test_statistics
files.about: The resampling and carry calculations behind the site's 95% ranges and fair prices, on known cases.

files.name: test_strategies
files.about: Unit tests for the strategy code: costs, no look-ahead, forced exits, the stress filter and the sealed guard.

files.name: test_trade_logs
files.about: Every stored trade log, checked trade by trade against the rules and against the raw prices.

files.name: test_video
files.about: The demo video says only what the data says: every number in its subtitles is checked.
